hint_ladder: State what you believe, while marking that your evidence is only what you have been able to see.
Put the phrase at the front of the sentence, before the comma, and let the claim follow.
Start with the words: ___, the system is working fine.
teaching_content.reveal_form: From what I can tell, the system is working fine.
canonical_forms: From what I can tell, the system is working fine.
alternative_realizations: From what I can tell, nobody has started the survey yet.
